positions.name: NeverCalibratedContest
positions.frame: What settles whether an instrument was ever calibrated when one account asserts calibration and another flatly denies it?
positions.why: src-3 is an unhedged assertive denial that the observatory ever calibrated the Kestrelwood spectrograph. It bears directly on the calibration-status subject of Narrative_CalibrationClaimsNeedVerification and runs against the calibration claim held by Position_KestrelwoodCalibrationVerification. No existing frame reads it as support, since that position's members affirm calibration. The statement offers no reference check or evidence of its own, so the tension stays open here and is not resolved. The directives src-1 and src-2 ask for removal of knowledge rather than witnessing the calibration subject, so they stay ungrouped.
